Excitement That Begins With The Drop Of Your Azoria Fiberglass Pool!

There’s nothing quite like the moment your new Azoria fiberglass pool is gently lowered into place — it’s the start of a backyard transformation you’ll never forget. At Hipel Pools, we combine precision installation with the elegance of Azoria’s premium fiberglass designs to create a space that feels uniquely yours. From the first drop to your first dive — and for many years to come — we’re by your side, ensuring your pool continues to deliver beauty, performance, and relaxation season after season.
How Much Does A Fiberglass Pool Cost?

Buying a swimming pool is a lot like purchasing a new home or car — there are countless styles, features, and options to choose from. At Hipel Pools, our goal is to make the decision to install a fiberglass pool  as clear and straightforward as possible.

Installing a fiberglass pool in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge & Guelph will cost a minimum of $70,000 and could cost upwards of $200,000 for large projects.

We have several pages on the Hipel Pools website dedicated specifically to pricing.

You can try our Pool Pricing Calculator or read our Fiberglass Pool Pricing Guide
Fiberglass Pools Vs Vinyl Pools: Which Is Better?

The truth is fiberglass pools aren't better than vinyl pools and vinyl pools aren't better than fiberglass pools. Each type of pool has unique advantages and disadvantages

The good news is we install both Fiberglass Pools & Vinyl Pools. We're not just another fiberglass pool company that's here to tell you that fiberglass pools are the greatest thing since sliced bread just so we can sell you a pool. We're here to work alongside you and help you make an educated decision on which type of pool will best suit you and your family for a lifetime of enjoyment. 
How Long Do Fiberglass Pools Last?

Fiberglass pools last a long time. Structurally they should last 30+ years if installed correctly. How long they last cosmetically however is highly dependent on how well you look after your pool. We've seen fiberglass pools that are structurally sound but after 3 years of neglect and lack luster maintenance look as if they are 40 years old. 

You should expect to refinish your fiberglass pool every 15 years but with proper care and routine maintenance this can be extended dramatically.
Can Fiberglass Pools Be Saltwater?

Yes! Fiberglass pools are saltwater compatible and over 95% of the pools we install in the Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge & Guelph Area are Saltwater fiberglass pools.

Salt water may not be the best sanitization option for you depending on where you live so we also offer alternative systems such as Ozone, UV, Mineral, & Traditional Chlorine.

 

 
How Long Does It Take To Install A Fiberglass Pool?

Typically in Ontario it takes between 3-10 days to install a fiberglass pool itself. However projects with full & extensive landscaping take anywhere between 4-8 weeks or even longer to complete depending on the full scope. 

On average it takes us 6 weeks to complete a full fiberglass pool project.
What Sizes Do Fiberglass Pools Come In?

Fiberglass pools come in sizes as small as 8'x8' more like a spa or plunge pool and go up to the maximum size of 16' Wide x 40' Long.

The most common sizes are 12' x 24', 14' x 30', and 16'x40.

The maximum deep end depth you can get with a fiberglass pool is 8' deep.
Are Fiberglass Pools Easier To Mantain Than Vinyl Liner Pools?

Both fiberglass pools and vinyl liner pools are generally fairly easy to maintain. They both have very smooth surfaces when compared to concrete pools which helps them to resist difficult stains and algae growth.

Vinyl pools do require vinyl liner replacements every 10-15 years while you can expect to refinish a fiberglass pool every 15 years.
Are Fiberglass Pools Good For Cold Climates? Fiberglass pools are excellent for cold climates that experience freeze thaw cycles. The extreme durability of the fiberglass shell combined the ability to be flexible with ground movements makes them an excellent choice in cold climates.
Certified Expertise. Exceptional Results.

Your Pool, Built by Certified Professionals

At Hipel Pools, we proudly hold both the PHTA Certified Builder Professional (CBP) and Certified Pool & Spa Operator (CPO) designations — two of the most respected credentials in the aquatic industry. These certifications represent our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and professionalism in every project we build and every pool we maintain. Unlike many builders, we continually invest in education and training to ensure our team remains at the forefront of modern construction standards, water chemistry management, and industry best practices. When you choose Hipel Pools, you’re choosing a partner dedicated to excellence — one that delivers expertly built, meticulously maintained pools designed for beauty, longevity, and your complete peace of mind.

Certified Builder Professional (CBP)The Certified Pool & Spa Builder (CBP) designation recognizes industry professionals who have demonstrated advanced knowledge, skill, and commitment to excellence in the design, construction, and project management of residential and commercial pools and spas.
Certified Pool & Spa Operator (CPO)The Certified Pool & Spa Operator (CPO) designation signifies a highly trained professional with expert knowledge in proper pool operation, advanced water chemistry, and safety standards, ensuring consistently clean, healthy, and perfectly maintained swimming environments.

Quality & Dependability You Can Count On

We’ve earned our reputation as a trusted fiberglass pool builder by being there when it matters most — delivering quality, dependability, and reliability in everything we do.
